_comment: How the plan reader talks to the model. DATA, not Kotlin constants — the model id in
particular, because both Llama 4 vision models were shut down mid-2026 (Scout on 17 July,
twelve days before this feature was designed) and any code written from prior knowledge would
have failed on its first call. A retired model must be a config edit, not a release.
reasoningEffort 'none' is the single biggest cost lever: qwen3.6 is a reasoning model and
reasoning tokens bill as output, but reading a plan is extraction, not deliberation. Measured:
21 paise a scan with reasoning off, 62 with it on.
userAgent is NOT decoration. Cloudflare fronts the Groq API and rejects an unknown client with
its own 403 (error 1010) before the request reaches the API at all.
The prompt lives in its own file so it diffs as prose. It is the EXACT text the 30 real plans
were measured with (tools/scan-eval, batch-real.py) — every accuracy figure this feature is
designed around was taken with these words, so changing them invalidates the numbers. Prompt
tuning is a deliberate, re-measured step, never a tweak.
